chapters.script: Welcome to Blog one, our multi-tenant agentic AI reference architecture and five-hop cryptographic governance baseline on Google Cloud.

chapters.title: The SaaS AI Architect's Dilemma: False Dichotomy of Multi-Tenancy
chapters.script: SaaS teams face a tough choice between fragile shared agents and expensive dedicated projects, which our three-pattern taxonomy solves.
metrics: Naive Shared Pools Leak Tool Schemas

chapters.title: The 5 Multi-Tenant Attack Vectors: Adversarial Flow Map
chapters.script: Adversaries exploit five cross-tenant vectors, from spoofed tenant headers and stolen tokens to noisy-neighbor exhaustion and prompt injection.

chapters.title: Control Plane, Compute & Data Plane Five-Hop Blueprint
chapters.script: Our five-hop pipeline separates control, compute, and data planes using signed tokens, scoped registries, rate bulkheads, and row-level security.

chapters.title: Five-Hop Cryptographic Request & Token Exchange Flow
chapters.script: Every request clears edge header stripping, short-lived ECDSA signing, registry filtering, Model Armor screening, and kernel-enforced database isolation.

chapters.title: L3 Process Architecture: Fail-Closed Security Circuit Breakers
chapters.script: At runtime, deterministic circuit breakers fail closed on every policy mismatch, returning strict status codes while emitting zero-PII audit logs.

chapters.title: Live Model Armor Console Proof: Unprotected Baseline vs. Firewall
chapters.script: These live Google Cloud Console captures prove Model Armor switches the exact same prompt injection from open pass to blocked violation.

chapters.title: Live Cloud Armor WAF: Open Edge vs. Priority 1000 Deny-403
chapters.script: At Hop one, Cloud Armor replaces an open edge rule with deterministic deny rules that reject spoofed tenant headers immediately.

chapters.title: Live ThoughtSpot Spotter: 6-Line Rollup vs. Single-Line Scope
